about_the_game:
Make decisions fun, fair, and completely random. Whether you're choosing what to eat, picking a winner for a livestream giveaway, running classroom activities, or playing party games with friends, Spin The Wheel, Random Picker turns every choice into an exciting experience.

Create fully customizable wheels and let fate decide.

KEY FEATURES:

Drag the Wheel to Spin

Spin the wheel naturally by dragging it with your mouse for a more interactive and realistic experience.

Pick Multiple Winners Automatically

Need more than one winner? Select how many winners you want and the wheel will automatically choose them during the spin.

Share Wheels with Anyone

Create a shareable wheel link so anyone can spin your wheel.

  • Share wheels with viewers, friends, or students

  • Import wheels created by other users

  • Manage your shared wheels using the Shared Links Manager

  • Spin shared wheels online without installing the app

Fully Customizable Wheels

Create wheels that match your style and needs.

  • Custom themes and background images

  • Custom fonts and colors

  • AI-generated color palettes

  • Adjustable slice weights for probability control

  • Enable or disable slices without deleting them

Flexible Text Display

Choose how wheel slices appear:

  • Show full text

  • Show divider symbols

  • Show color-only slices for very large wheels

Auto Fit Text automatically adjusts text to fit inside slices for better readability.

You can also show or hide slice borders for different visual styles.

Last Man Wins Mode

An exciting elimination mode where the wheel spins multiple times, removing slices randomly until only one winner remains.

Perfect for tournaments, party games, or classroom activities.

Music, Sounds, and Spin Effects

Enhance the experience with:

  • Background music

  • Decision sounds

  • Spin FX effects

  • Winner voice announcer in multiple languages

True Random Results

Every spin uses a fair random system. Results are never influenced by spin strength, timing, or angle.

Optimized for Large Wheels

Improved performance allows the app to handle large wheels with many slices while maintaining smooth animations.

Perfect For

  • Stream giveaways

  • Classroom activities

  • Party games

  • Family decisions

  • Chore assignments

  • Tournament eliminations

  • Random name pickers

  • RPG or character name selection

Make decisions exciting and interactive instead of stressful.

Spin the wheel and let fate decide.
